items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: Wadsworth was the guy that, uh, really booked the job and landed the job and hired Kelly as the banjo player.

ctx.x: Waddy Wadsworth landed the job, the saxophone player, who had had the band at the Winter Garden that I told you about. And, uh, so, Bert Kelly was a pretty smart guy. And he, he said to the boys as they were getting there at the end of the week, he said, gee, he says, uh, here are the four of us. We are here. We got the job. We ought to have somebody that could talk to the boss. And Bert says, I'll talk to him. He, he's the one that brought it up. And he also said, I'll talk to him. If that's all right. They…
You mean the boss would pay Bert and then Bert split it up?
